steps.term: Looped transformer: the same layers applied again
steps.say: The first four run once, the loop runs twice, the last four once. Fifty-six executions from thirty-two layers.
Each pass carries two residual streams, averaged into one vector between passes.
The bill is the cache. Every execution keeps its own slot: fifty-six kibibytes a token, near the twenty-seven B's sixty-four.

steps.term: mHC: streams mixed under a constraint
steps.say: A router mixes the two streams through a matrix whose rows and columns sum to one. Signals blend, but cannot grow.
